objective.primary: Discover which pregame WNBA signal families provide reproducible incremental predictive value and whether a selective Elite regime can reach at least 0.80 out-of-sample accuracy at meaningful coverage without leakage or post-result threshold selection.
objective.secondary: Develop a distinct R3 probability candidate whose discrimination and calibration can later be tested on an independent prospective cohort for cross-sport eligibility.
not_an_objective: Make the closed R2 candidate pass by weakening the frozen ECE10 gate.
Claim 80 percent accuracy on all WNBA games.
Mine arbitrary subsets after observing target outcomes and present them as certified.
Use sportsbook prices as a sporting feature in the R3 sports-only candidate.

data_status.independent_certification_source: A separately frozen prospective/new cohort not used to choose R3 features, interactions, thresholds, model family, or calibration parameters.

BASE_R2.description: R2 leakage-safe fallback sporting state: ratings, pace, win rate, recent form, SOS, rest, B2B, schedule load, streak and deployed travel semantics; availability neutralized.

allowed_components: effective field goal percentage when reconstructible from prior-game boxscore fields
FOUR_FACTORS.requirement: Every target-game value must be derived strictly from finalized games on prior official dates.

allowed_components: offensive style versus opponent defensive profile interactions
SHOT_PROFILE_MATCHUP.requirement: Historical values must be prefix-derived; current/end-of-season ESPN aggregates may not be substituted backward.

allowed_components: recent margin or possession efficiency derived only from prior games

H2H_PREFIX.requirement: Only meetings strictly before the target date; H2H must prove incremental value and is not assumed useful.

allowed_components: actual prior-to-target location sequence if venue-coordinate custody is certified
timezone or travel-distance sequence if reconstructible without target outcomes

allowed_interactions: offensive shooting profile versus opponent defensive profile
offensive rebounding strength versus opponent defensive rebounding weakness
free-throw pressure versus opponent foul/free-throw allowance when reconstructible
availability loss interacted with team depth/usage concentration when custody exists
fatigue interacted with rotation/pace when custody exists

MULTIDIMENSIONAL_DOMINANCE.description: A side may qualify only from prespecified independent signal-family advantages; dominance cannot be defined from target outcomes or sportsbook prices.

development_protocol.evaluation_style: rolling-origin by season with all target-season thresholds and fitted parameters learned from earlier seasons only
ablation_order: bounded combinations that contain only signal families which first demonstrate incremental OOS value
development_protocol.incremental_value_rule: A signal family must improve at least one proper scoring metric out of sample without materially degrading both other probability-quality metrics, and its directional contribution must not depend on a single target season, before it may enter a bounded combination.
development_protocol.availability_rule: Availability cannot participate in historical combination tests unless timestamped historical custody is separately certified; otherwise it is prospective-only.
